item.title: Pirate Borg: Running the Dark Caribbean
item.description: A GM's briefing on the setting of Pirate Borg. What the Dark Caribbean is, the real Golden Age of Piracy history it's built on (Nassau's pirate republic, the sinking of Port Royal, Tortuga's buccaneers, the Spanish treasure fleets, and where the Yucatan actually is), and then the twist: the Scourge, ASH, the six-chapter apocalypse, the seven powers from the pirate republic to the Wretched cult, the vibe of each island, and what the monster list tells you about the tone. Ends with how it actually feels to run at the table.
